actual_representation_theorem.claim: The first-moment sequence representation has parameter-independent collisions, so arbitrary within-span ordering tasks cannot all be solved byv2.
actual_representation_theorem.conditions: Same validated prompt/options, one sentence span, tokenizer-normalized tokens; token composition depends only on spelling, as in the current source. Local record indices can differ but their token vectors correspond.
actual_representation_theorem.formula: E(t_0,...,t_(L-1))=(1/L)sum_i[1+gamma*(2i/(L-1)-1)]*f(t_i), componentwise. Equal token counts and equal per-token position-index sums imply equal encodings for all embeddings and learned gamma.
actual_representation_theorem.relevance_limit: This proves a broader order-representation defect. It does not prove that the actual curriculum pairs collide or explain all observed errors.
actual_representation_theorem.witness: Single-span context token sequences a b b a . and b a a b . have the same counts and per-token position sums (a:3,b:3,period:4); the question Which symbol appears first? with the same a/b options has different truth but identical network logits for all weights.

completed_observations.uniform_NLL_source: Analytic candidate-count baseline: four4-way families and two2-way families with equal row counts; no model or row evaluation.

most_likely_mechanism.hypothesis: Binding information is compressed into weak low-dimensional linear first-moment sentence summaries before nonlinear question/candidate interaction. Static one-read attention can remain nearuniform, making grouped same-bag counterfactual worlds nearly indistinguishable to the final scorer. Balanced swaps remove profitable bag shortcuts, and the short fixed fit can settle on marginal answer priors instead of learning association-sensitive attention.
most_likely_mechanism.numeric_limit: Numerals are nominal tokens; candidate anchors are decoded only after scoring; categorical training contains no numeric comparison or ordinal-distance inductive bias.
most_likely_mechanism.single_read_limit: There is no query update, contextual token encoder, explicit subject-value binding channel or iterative relation join. This is a concrete architectural omission, not an absolute finite-task expressivity theorem.
most_likely_mechanism.status: source-supported inductive-bias/optimization explanation, not measured causal identification

next_architecture_requirement.controls: New architecture identity, independent forward/gradient tests and training-only static work preflight; retain old outcomes and artifacts, no implicit production promotion.
next_architecture_requirement.minimal_experiment: A separately versioned v3 may first move nonlinear question/candidate compatibility inside each fact before aggregating, then add two-read memory. Compare on fresh frozen grouped challenge slices; no tuning or rerunning the consumedv1 cohort.
next_architecture_requirement.numeric_semantics: If finite comparison/ordinal reasoning is a product requirement, supply an explicitly bounded numeric representation/module with its own exact tests rather than assuming byte embeddings learn arithmetic.
next_architecture_requirement.primary: Preserve and learn entity/relation/value interaction before irreversible pooling: contextual token states or per-fact nonlinear cross-attention jointly conditioned on question tokens and candidate tokens, with explicit position and a stable token-identity alignment channel for novel names.
next_architecture_requirement.quality_guarantee: None; this addresses an architectural mechanism and requires fresh empirical validation. No LAYA/JEV parity or near100percent promise.
next_architecture_requirement.relational_extension: Use at least an updated-query second memory read or explicit learned key-value join for two-hop tasks, followed by a shared complete-candidate scorer.

what_is_established: The fitted compact model fails on the training-side entity-binding challenge, not only on new entity names or changed wording: none of160 changed-gold training pairs changes its top semantic answer.
The result gives no support for useful held-out synthetic transfer; evaluation23/72 is below the uniform expected24/72. Grouped public synthetic tasks are not an independent real benchmark.
Final training NLL is only slightly better than the analytic uniform1.1552453009332422nats; development/evaluation NLL are worse than that baseline.
The new generator makes complete subject-bearing facts available in each sentence, removing the earlier omitted-subject status/semicolon confound for this attempt.
what_is_not_established: Top-answer stability does not prove that paired probability vectors or hidden states are identical.
No attention/gradient/parameter diagnostic was read; nearuniform attention, small binding gradients, optimization collapse or learned priors remain mechanistic hypotheses.
The current architecture is not provably invariant to every generated assignment swap: sentence composition, learned position and candidate-conditioned softmax attention can distinguish them.
No theorem states that this finite six-family curriculum is impossible for everyv2 parameter setting, or that six epochs was sufficient.
A further fit, more data or a proposed replacement architecture is not thereby known to improve accuracy.
